official_sources: Assets of Community Value England Regulations 2012

official_measurement_examples.name: Five-year listing
official_measurement_examples.fact: Successful ACV listings generally remain on the local authority register for five years unless removed or relisted under the statutory process.

official_measurement_examples.name: Moratorium trigger
official_measurement_examples.fact: A relevant proposed disposal can trigger an interim/full moratorium allowing eligible community groups time to prepare a bid.

official_measurement_examples.name: Right to bid only
official_measurement_examples.fact: Community Right to Bid is not a right to buy and is not a right of first refusal.

official_measurement_examples.name: Owner sale freedom
official_measurement_examples.fact: After the statutory process, the owner is generally not forced to sell to the community bidder or at a specified price.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: ACV designation does not itself prohibit an owner from seeking planning permission for change of use or redevelopment.

official_measurement_examples.name: Local register authority
official_measurement_examples.fact: ACV registers are maintained by local authorities and current, expired and unsuccessful nominations must remain distinct.

official_measurement_examples.name: Land charge context
official_measurement_examples.fact: ACV status may be protected as a local land charge but that does not establish freehold ownership or development capacity.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: ACV status does not determine market value, ownership, planning outcome or final development yield.

core_rules: ACV listing is not planning permission
ACV listing is not planning refusal
community right to bid is not right of first refusal
community right to bid is not right to buy
moratorium is disposal-process control not ownership transfer
ACV listing normally expires after five years unless relisted
current and expired listings must remain distinct
local register is authoritative for local status
listing does not determine market value
listing does not determine land ownership
listing does not prohibit all change of use or redevelopment
planning consequences remain proposal and policy specific
land-charge registration is not parcel title ownership
absence from one published register extract is not definitive absence without current local check
no parcel ACV clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
